results.title: Outrageous Fortune
results.overview: Refined actress Lauren Ames finally has a chance to study with the great theatre professor Stanislav Korzenowski. Sandy Brozinsky, a brash, loud actress, decides through happenstance to also study with Korzenowski. The two women end up dating the same man (who turns out to be a double agent) and follow him across the country to force him to choose between them.

results.title: Outrageous Fortune
results.overview: Outrageous Fortune follows the evening of an actor’s life before his performance of the titular role in William Shakespeare’s Hamlet. His drab reality influences his emotional performance, as his current existence seems to reflect Hamlet’s.

results.title: Arrows of Outrageous Fortune
results.overview: George Arrow bequeaths his only son Henry a mansion filled with insane women.

results.title: Outrageous Fortune: The Movie
results.overview: It's Christmas 2006. Wolf's in prison to stay, Judd's in prison and trying to get out. The family is going to Tutaekuri Bay, where they go to every year — only some things have changed. Who is that in "their" spot? Who put a gate up stopping access to "their" beach? Who will win the bet on when Pascalle will give it up? And why do they always come here in the first place?
